scope: Primary-source literature and open-source research relevant to improving the submitted 22.2427257787 packing portfolio. No solver run or new score claimed.

sources.title: Improved Dense Packings of Congruent Squares in a Square
sources.evidence: Section 6 describes random feasible moves, adaptive amplitudes, joint position/angle perturbation and reinflation; improvements were found for 11, 29, 37.
sources.application: Use adaptive kick-and-quench around structured incumbents, rather than independent random placements.
sources.limit: Historical small-n evidence; not a guarantee on n up to 1000.

sources.title: Evan Daniel square-packing packer research
sources.evidence: C25: fresh public packings followed by composition yielded n>324 records. C27: only binding pieces transmit their improvement to a composite. C45: five of six rectangle-composition records reproduced. C46-C47: allowing slack constructions followed by exploration was essential in several examples.
sources.application: Target bottleneck gadgets, maintain diverse parents, compose at temporarily larger L then relax. Rust fq/anneal/harden and Python crop/composition tools are public.
sources.limit: Most detailed benchmarks concern n=110 or n<=324. Numerical speedups and success rates should not be extrapolated unchanged.

sources.title: Square Packing
sources.evidence: Author reports random GPU searches jam above about n=130; V-bands with integer-programmed upright corner fills, softening/re-hardening, and rectangular composition produced new layouts. Record structures can merge separate tilted bands into one.
sources.application: Search structural band/corner parameters and selectively soften contacts, with geometric compositions as starts.
sources.limit: Published repository exposes records and verification code; full GPU generator was not found in the public tree.

sources.title: Squares in squares: 39 improved packings
sources.evidence: Public SLP optimizes x/y/theta and L with analytic contact derivatives, elastic slack, adaptive trust regions, second-order corrections, and HiGHS IPM. Historical 39 improvements compare to the catalogue of 2026-09-23.
sources.application: Use as a small transparent polishing/reference solver after structural moves.
sources.limit: Historical records are largely superseded and do not establish additional gain over the submitted November baseline.

sources.title: Soft-to-Rigid: Shape Continuation as an Alternative Search for Packing Congruent Shapes
sources.evidence: Inradius-preserving Minkowski rounding interpolates disks to polygons. Paper finds complementary small-square packings but says hardening is not the better default and does not prove that splitting a fixed budget between methods pays.
sources.application: Try local or partial re-hardening of band junctions; preserve useful structure rather than rebuilding large-n instances from disks.
sources.limit: Square benchmarks mainly n<=30. Larger-n transfer is a research hypothesis, not a reported result.

sources.title: Improved Packings of n(n-1) Unit Squares in a Square
sources.evidence: Constructive squeezable rectangles and tilted stacks establish below-grid families and extension inequalities; rectangular components propagate compression to larger instances.
sources.application: Generalize square-only donors to nearly-square rectangular components and parameterized tilt families.
sources.limit: Existence below a grid ceiling does not imply improvement over the current public packing; landing-page and PDF boundary n=12 wording differs.

sources.title: Square packing with O(x^0.6) wasted area
sources.evidence: Constructive asymptotic W(x)=O(x^(3/5)); square is reduced to right trapezoids then tightly packed almost-rectangular quadrilaterals with nonparallel sides.
sources.application: Investigate multi-angle tapered bands and trapezoidal end-cap primitives.
sources.limit: Asymptotic constants and thresholds are not a usable guarantee at competition side lengths <=32; no ready-to-use solver found.

sources.title: Optimally Packing a Large Square by Unit Squares
sources.evidence: Another O(x^(3/5)) waste construction alternates two stack-packing routines inside narrow trapezoidal gaps.
sources.application: A distinct source of finite multiscale boundary templates and angle transitions.
sources.limit: The title does not mean optimal packings for each n are solved. Practical benefit for n<=1000 is unestablished.

secondary_resource_caution.findings: Kaggle export documentation still names metric v17; current README says new n>324 rows are not published during the competition. Useful exact donors and source lineage, not evidence of a stronger downloadable current full portfolio.
